title: hiitl Execution Envelope
description: Every supplied number, including open caller data, follows sync_engine.md#numeric-domain before evaluation, signing, hashing or recording. Language-neutral specification for the execution envelope. Source of truth for all language implementations. An optional field is written by leaving it out; null is a value only where a type names it.

schema_version.description: Version of this envelope schema, 'v{major}.{minor}'. An envelope of another major version is refused, naming the version it carries and the version taken, with the migration note of the bump (this schema's $comment); there is no acceptance window.

org_id.description: Organization identifier. Tenant isolation boundary. Format: org_{random}

environment.description: Environment this action is executing in. Isolation boundary within org.

agent_id.description: Stable identifier for the agent (across runs). SDK config value.

agent_instance_id.description: Per-run instance identifier for the agent. Optional. Useful for distributed systems.

user_id.description: End-user identifier (if action is on behalf of a user). Optional.

session_id.description: Session identifier. Optional. Groups actions within a user session.

action_id.description: Client-generated unique identifier for this action. Format: act_{ulid or uuid}

idempotency_key.description: Idempotency key for deduplication. Prevents duplicate execution on retry. Client-generated.

correlation_id.description: The caller's own ID tying this action to others, such as a request ID. Optional. Supplied by the caller (the SDKs' evaluate() option correlation_id) and recorded as given.

trace_id.description: OpenTelemetry trace ID of the span active when the action was evaluated, in W3C Trace Context's form (32 lowercase hex), the event's span.trace_id. Optional. Auto-propagated from execution context: the SDKs read it from the active span when the OpenTelemetry API is installed (never a dependency) and leave it unset otherwise. Another form is refused, naming the field (1.5); a caller's own id is correlation_id.

action.description: Name of the action being evaluated. Primary classification field. Replaces tool_name (1.1), whose alias leaves at 2.0: an envelope carrying tool_name is refused as a field the schema does not define, naming action.

action_type.description: Type classification for the action. Optional secondary classification.

operation.description: CRUD operation type. Indicates the nature of the action. Defaults to 'execute' if omitted.

target.description: Resource identifiers. What is this action targeting? Structured JSON. Defaults to empty object if omitted.

parameters.description: Structured action parameters. Action-specific. JSON object. Defaults to empty object if omitted.

sensitivity.description: Risk signal: sensitivity classification. Multiple classifications allowed.

cost_estimate.description: Risk signal: estimated cost of this action. Optional. Closed (v1.4, 2026-11-04): a key other than these three is refused, naming it - no field is ever silently dropped (R-0872).

confidence.description: Risk signal: confidence score from upstream AI system. Optional. Range 0.0-1.0.

requested_scopes.description: Risk signal: permission scopes requested for this action. Optional.

principal.description: The VERIFIED principal: the subject and scopes of a token a verifier checked (MCP authorization spec 2026-07-28: RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata, RFC 8707 audience binding). Set only by a verifier - an SDK's configured principal verifier from a token passed to evaluate(), or (follow-on) the hosted service or MCP proxy from a validated token - never accepted as a free value. Distinct from agent_id, user_id and requested_scopes, which are strings the caller supplies. Identity and permission-scope policies condition on principal.sub / principal.scopes only. Optional.

scopes.description: The scopes the token grants (OAuth scope, split).

iss.description: The issuer that signed the token.

aud.description: The audience the token is bound to (RFC 8707 resource).

verified_at.description: When the token was checked, an RFC 3339 date-time read by that grammar (ecp_evaluate_spec.md).

reason.description: Context: brief reason for this action. For audit trail. Limited length. DO NOT include full prompts.

prompt_hash.description: Context: hash of the prompt that led to this action. Optional. For audit without logging full prompt.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time when envelope was created, read by that grammar (ecp_evaluate_spec.md "A date-time is read by RFC 3339's grammar"). Required. Used for replay attack prevention.

signature.description: HMAC-SHA256 signature under the API key's signing secret, over the RFC 8785 (JCS) form of the envelope without its signature. Required. Prevents tampering.

signature_version.description: The signature's version, inside the signed form, so the record names the version that signed it. No request header names it. A change to the signed form is a new value. Optional, defaults to 'hmac-sha256-v1'.

metadata.description: Additional metadata. Optional. Not used in policy evaluation. Free-form.

$comment: Version 2.0 (2026-11-07, HTL-24 row 223, ruled 2026-11-07) - the major version, by R-0007 ('Backward-compatible field additions only ... Migration path documented before breaking changes') and 1.3's 'removed at the next major version'. It carries 1.5's trace_id pattern and removes policy_refs. $id is v2 and schema_version takes v2.{minor}. Migration: set schema_version to v2.0 (both SDKs build it); drop policy_refs, which nothing read (a v2 envelope carrying it is refused as an undefined field, naming it, as at 1.4); send action, never tool_name: the alias 1.1 took leaves at 2.0 (gap row 225, ruled 2026-11-08), so an envelope carrying tool_name is refused as an undefined field, naming action, and a policy condition on tool_name is refused by the lint, naming action; give trace_id in W3C Trace Context's form, or move another id to correlation_id (1.5). An envelope carrying a v1 schema_version is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR / ENVELOPE_VALIDATION_ERROR in the hosted service, the core model's error in an SDK), naming the version it carries, the version taken and this note: no acceptance window, no dual handling. Records written before 2.0 are held as written and are not read again against this schema (Principle 6). Version 1.5 (2026-11-06, HTL-23 row 210, ruled 2026-11-06) - trace_id takes the pattern ^[0-9a-f]{32}$, W3C Trace Context's form, in place of maxLength 128. A breaking change, entered by its migration path: an envelope whose trace_id is in another form is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR / ENVELOPE_VALIDATION_ERROR in the hosted service, the core model's error in an SDK), naming trace_id. The SDKs set trace_id only from the active span (HTL-22 row 175), so a client of this SDK release sends no other form; a caller that builds its own envelope and puts its own id in trace_id moves that id to correlation_id, which takes it as given (1 to 128 characters). Records written before 1.5 are held as written and are not read again against this schema (Principle 6). Version 1.4 (2026-11-04, R-0872) - cost_estimate is closed: an undefined key is refused, naming it, as at the top level. Version 1.3 (2026-10-10) - policy_refs deprecated: accepted, ignored, removed at the next major version; the envelope never names the policies that apply. Version 1.2 (2026-10-08, T-130 A7) - added principal, the verified principal. Version 1.1 - Renamed tool_name to action. Made operation/target/parameters optional with defaults. Backward compatibility: tool_name accepted as alias for action. Language-neutral. All implementations must validate against this schema.
